csv_scope_of_work: Design Build Services for Little Creek Campground. The subject requirement consists of all labor, materials, equipment, and supervision to design and construct new developed infrastructure at Little Creek Campground, UT. The project will address erosion, traffic circulation, sun exposure, and limited OHV/trailer parking within the existing campground. These improvements will support growing visitation, and enhance the visitor experience, improve accessibility, reduce overcrowding, and restore overall site functionality and safety. This project is located at Little Creek Campground, located on Little Creek Road approximately 3 miles West of Randolph, Utah.
